description: Address high-priority issues from code review: mask CI secrets, logout fail-closed, stale docstring, dead config removal.
steps: STEP 1 - Add ::add-mask:: to deploy-all.yml KeyVault fetch step: For each secret fetched from Azure KeyVault, add echo '::add-mask::$VAR_NAME' BEFORE writing the secret to GITHUB_ENV. This prevents GitHub Actions from showing secrets in workflow logs.

STEP 2 - Make logout() fail closed on Redis outage: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py, change the logout endpoint to raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail='Token revocation service unavailable') when Redis is unavailable, matching the fail-closed behavior of get_current_user and refresh_token_endpoint.

STEP 3 - Fix stale logout docstring and remove conditional: Update the logout docstring to say refresh_token is required (not optional). Remove the 'if body.refresh_token:' conditional since the field now has min_length=1. Add Field(min_length=1) to LogoutRequest.refresh_token.

STEP 4 - Remove dead config: Remove AZURE_EMBEDDING_MODEL and AZURE_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS from apps/backend/app/config.py since they are no longer referenced in application code after the embedder rewrite.
acceptance_criteria: Each secret in deploy-all.yml has ::add-mask:: before GITHUB_ENV write
logout() raises HTTPException(503) when Redis is unavailable
Logout docstring says refresh_token is required
AZURE_EMBEDDING_MODEL and AZURE_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS removed from config.py
verification: Run: grep -n 'min_length=1' apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py should find LogoutRequest field
Run: grep -n 'AZURE_EMBEDDING' apps/backend/app/config.py should return empty
Run: pytest apps/backend/tests/ --tb=short -q (same 8 pre-existing failures, 30 passes)
findings: All 8 test failures are pre-existing (verified by stashing changes and running tests on base state). The webhook tests fail because Redis mock is not properly applied in the test fixtures.
